name: Takanawadai
tagline: Shinagawa in 10 minutes and Shibuya in 17 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥120,000 to ¥130,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, served by Toei Asakusa Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 21 minutes to Otemachi, 25 minutes to Shinjuku, 17 minutes to Shibuya and 10 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. The station stands 28.1 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 18.2 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 28.1 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 9.9 m to 28.1 m, a difference of 18.2 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 7 clinics and 10 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 地域医療機能推進機構東京高輪病院, about 3 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is NTT東日本関東病院, about 7 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Toei Asakusa Line.
congestion: Toei Asakusa Line runs at 123% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 本所吾妻橋→浅草, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥120,000 to ¥130,000 and 1K ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. 1LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000 and 2LDK ¥430,000 to ¥440,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the high side. a small projected flood depth pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station and little daily shopping within walking distance holds it down. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For rail connections, Shirokanedai; for how close the centre is, Takanawadai.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Takanawadai. Shirokanedai also has the Tokyo Metro Namboku Line and Toei Mita Line, which Takanawadai does not. With more lines, Shirokanedai is the better connected of the two. To Shinagawa, for instance, Shirokanedai takes 11 minutes longer. A one-room flat, though, costs about ¥24,000 more at Shirokanedai.

neighbours.lead: For rail connections, Gotanda; for how little of the area is in the flood projection, Takanawadai.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Takanawadai. Gotanda also has the JR Yamanote Line and Tokyu Ikegami Line, which Takanawadai does not. With more lines, Gotanda is the better connected of the two. To Shinjuku, for instance, Gotanda is 7 minutes quicker. On how little of the area is in the flood projection, though, Takanawadai comes out ahead.

noiseSources: 桜田通り (4 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 4 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 9 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Neither the station nor the ground around it falls inside the projected flood area.
leads.stationNote: Only the Toei Asakusa Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
